$comment: Time-limited, evidence-based PRODUCTION dependency exceptions for the SafeBet IQ production monorepo (frontend/). Consumed by scripts/ci/security-gate.mjs (SBIQ_AUDIT_DIR=frontend). A CRITICAL is NEVER excepted. Only HIGH advisories with NO available non-major fix are listed. AUD-P1-001/008. After the AUD-P1 remediation: production criticals = 0 (html2pdf.js->0.14.0, jspdf, next->13.5.11 resolved); lodash/nanoid/ws clean-fixed. The only remaining Highs are next + its transitive postcss, fixable solely by the Next 16 MAJOR upgrade (a separate migration + QA milestone).

policy.notes: Gate fails on any production Critical (no exceptions) and any production High not covered by a non-expired exception below.

advisories: Residual Next.js High advisory fixed only in Next 16 (13.5.x carries the patchable criticals fixed at 13.5.11; this remaining High needs a major upgrade)
exceptions.exploitability: LOW — production frontend is served behind CloudFront/WAF; route handlers validate auth server-side; the cache-poisoning + SSRF-in-Server-Actions criticals are already remediated at 13.5.11 (no 'use server' / experimental.serverActions in use).
exceptions.compensatingControl: CloudFront/WAF fronting; no Server Actions; auth validated per request.
exceptions.approvedBy: Meeshan Naidoo (required for the Next major upgrade)
exceptions.upgradePlan: Dedicated Next 16 upgrade milestone (App Router migration + full regression + Playwright). Not bundled with this critical/secret remediation.

advisories: postcss advisory carried by the Next 13.5.x bundled toolchain (transitive via next); the direct devDependency postcss is patched to 8.5.15
exceptions.exploitability: LOW — postcss runs at BUILD time only (Next CSS pipeline); no attacker-controlled CSS is processed; no runtime CSS stringify of untrusted input.
exceptions.compensatingControl: Build-time only; first-party static CSS; direct postcss devDep already patched to 8.5.15.
exceptions.upgradePlan: Resolved by the Next 16 upgrade milestone (which updates the bundled toolchain).
